title: +*MODERN CONFRONTATIONS: ORIGINS OF THE WEST III
description: Introduces the political, social, religious, and cultural history of modern Europe and its cultural successors in the Americas and other imperial contexts. Interrogates the concept of "the West" in an historical and scholarly context. Covers 1789 to the present.
